entities.name: Jerzy Adamski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jerzy Adamski was a Polish featherweight boxer who won a silver medal at the 1960 Olympics and a European title in 1959. He won six national titles and had an amateur record of 237 wins, 10 losses and 23 draws. Adamski was awarded the Order of Polonia Restituta.
